documents.emptyTitle: Your lab results will appear here
documents.emptyDesc: Upload a PDF from the lab: known lab report formats are read right away, and AI helps with the rest.

sample.invite: Is your lab not on the list? Send a sample lab report so it can be added in future versions of MedControl.
sample.title: Sample lab report
sample.intro: A new lab only needs the text of the lab report, the PDF itself is not sent anywhere. Names, addresses, and unknown words below are masked, all digits are replaced with random ones, and all dates are the same.
sample.check: Read the whole text. The automatic cleanup may have missed something: if you see a name, date of birth, address, phone number, or document number, delete it right here.
sample.restore: If a marker name got masked, you can type it back in.
sample.consent: I have read the text and it contains no personal data
sample.whereTo: The text goes to the MedControl developers. It is kept for no more than 180 days and deleted as soon as the lab is added.
sample.offNote: Sending samples is not set up yet. You can copy the text.
sample.thanks: Thank you! The sample was sent. If we can add this lab, it will appear in a future version.

monthReview.desc: The model looks at all of the month's lab results together: blood, liver, kidneys, thyroid, urine, plus the last six months of history, imaging, treatment, and the diary. The summary is saved in “Treatment history” and appears in the feed.

refs.title: Lab reference ranges
refs.desc: Results are compared with one reference range per marker, not with the one each lab printed. By default this is the MedControl catalog for adults; if a marker is not in the catalog, the range from the lab report is used. For any marker you can set a custom range or choose “as on the lab report”. The catalog is approximate: a doctor can give the exact ranges.
refs.sexHint: Hemoglobin, creatinine, ferritin, and several other markers have different ranges for men and women. If sex is not specified, the range from the lab report is used for them.
refs.labChosen: as on the lab report · your choice
refs.labNoSex: from the lab report until sex is specified
refs.labNotInCatalog: from the lab report, not in the catalog

refSheet.title: Reference range: {name}
refSheet.desc: All results for this marker are compared with this range: the “High” and “Low” flags, the Summary, alerts, AI texts, and the doctor report. The range from the lab report is kept with each result and shown in the document.
refSheet.labHint: Each result has its own range, as printed by the lab
refSheet.customHint: You can leave one limit empty: “up to 40” or “from 1”.
